description: Schema v2 FACTS, OUTCOME, and TIER-ATTRIBUTION ground-truth labels for OffSec Proving Grounds Practice cohorts PG-1, PG-2, and PG-3 (62 machines, 201 cases). Stores zero verbatim corpus output and sanitizes all target identifiers per CORPUS-MINING.md Principles 5 and 7.

cases.note: Command-only Nmap code fence with omitted stdout must classify as unknown and never hallucinate host reachability, open ports, or Active Directory roles from CLI flags alone.
Command-less Windows SPN enumeration line (SPN(1) = MSSQLSvc/<fqdn>) must extract host.fqdn, host.domain, and ad.domain_known without claiming a Kerberos TGS ticket hash or credential.

Nmap version and NSE scan of a standalone Windows mail and web host exposing anonymous FTP, IIS HTTP, SMB, and port 9998 HTTP must mint service reachability and anonymous FTP facts without promoting to ad.dc_candidate.

Interactive FTP session returning 220 Microsoft FTP Service and 230 User logged in for anonymous must mint ftp.reachable, ftp.banner, ftp.anonymous_login, and Windows OS family without claiming write access.
Elevated Windows PowerShell prompt running whoami and returning nt authority\system must establish foothold.windows and access.system without Linux foothold false positives.

RustScan and Nmap -sVC output with verbose syn-ack REASON column disclosing zFTPServer, Apache httpd 2.2.21 on port 242, and RDP must strip syn-ack before extracting service.version and exploit.versioned_banner.

Retrieved Apache .htpasswd ($apr1$ hash) and .htaccess (AuthUserFile c:\\wamp\www\.htpasswd) must mint crackable hash facts and must not misparse an escaped local Windows drive path (c:\\...) as an SMB UNC share.
John the Ripper live md5crypt cracking session recovering a username and cleartext password must mint credential.candidate, credential.plaintext, credential.password, and credential.available.

Truncated Windows systeminfo output (ending at OS Version before System Type) where codepage trademark rendering prints Microsoftr Windows Serverr 2008 Standard must trigger stateless Windows enum detection and mint host.kernel without fabricating host.arch.
Nmap scan reporting IIS 10.0 on port 80 and Sonatype Nexus/3.21.0-05 (OSS) via http-server-header NSE output on port 8081 must mint exploit.versioned_banner so Stage 1 searchsploit lookup unlocks.

FTP login attempt rejected with 534 Local policy on server does not allow TLS secure connections, 534 Policy requires SSL, and Login failed must classify as rejected rather than success and never mint ftp.anonymous_login.
Command-less PowerUp writable PATH DLL hijack stanza (HijackablePath and AbuseFunction : Write-HijackDll) must mint privesc.dll_hijack_candidate and privesc.leads.
Nmap scan of a single-port Windows Apache 2.4.48 (Win64) PHP/8.0.7 server must mint host.up, ports.open, port:80, http.reachable, web.server, service.version, and Windows host.os_family.
Unprompted multi-command bare fence listing whoami and hostname without inline stdout must not treat the sibling command token hostname as a POSIX username or mint false-positive foothold.linux.
Command-less Windows token privilege table showing SeImpersonatePrivilege Enabled must mint privesc.windows_privilege, privesc.seimpersonate, and privesc.leads.

RustScan and Nmap -sVC scan with syn-ack REASON column disclosing Bitvise WinSSHD 8.48, SMB, and Argus Surveillance DVR HTTP title on port 8080 must mint reachability, service.version, and exploit.versioned_banner.

Key-based SSH login whose empty stdout transitions directly into a Windows cmd prompt line (C:\Users\<user>\Desktop>) must mint ssh.authenticated, foothold.windows, and host.os_family via prompt telemetry.

CrackMapExec SMB credential check confirming local Administrator authentication with (Pwn3d!) must mint smb.authenticated, credential.available, credential.validated, and access.admin without promoting to ad.dc_candidate.
Command-only Nmap block with omitted stdout must classify as unknown and mint zero host or service facts.
Standalone HTTP URL containing an attacker UNC callback query parameter (?url=\\<lhost>\test) must not misclassify the query parameter as an enumerated target SMB share or mint smb.shares.

RustScan and Nmap -sVC output with syn-ack REASON column on a standalone WORKGROUP Windows Server 2008 host running Apache Tomcat/Coyote JSP engine 1.1 on port 8080 must extract service.version without promoting WORKGROUP to ad.dc_candidate.
Windows cmd prompt inside C:\ManageEngine\ServiceDesk\bin running whoami and returning nt authority\system must mint foothold.windows, access.system, and Windows host.os_family.

Full TCP Nmap version and default-script scan discovering anonymous FTP on non-standard port 20001 (FileZilla ftpd 0.9.41 beta), Mercury/32 imapd 4.62 on port 143, SMTP on port 25, VNC on port 11100, SMB on 139/445, and HTTP on 443/2224/8000 must mint reachability and versioned-banner facts without minting a phantom port:21.

OCR-spliced raw Netcat IMAP4rev1 transcript showing server greeting banner, tagged LOGIN command acceptance (OK LOGIN completed), and LIST mailbox enumeration must mint mail reachability, IMAP banner, and credential validation.

Full TCP Nmap version scan of an Active Directory Domain Controller exposing Kerberos 88, LDAP 389/3268 with inline Domain banner metadata, SMB 445, MSSQL 1433, RDP 3389, HTTP 80, and WinRM 5985 must mint DC candidacy, AD domain/base-DN linkage, and service reachabilities.

OCR-spliced NetExec SMB password-spray output with cropped leading protocol/IP columns must recover SMB authentication and plaintext credential facts via Tier-3 structural inference without falsely minting administrative access.
OCR-spliced authenticated rpcclient session running enumdomgroups and queryuser must mint Active Directory group and user lists.

RustScan/Nmap service-version scan with syn-ack REASON column identifying Windows Server 2008 SP1 MSRPC, SMB (139/445), RDP (3389), and baseline Microsoft-HTTPAPI/2.0 (5357) must mint Windows OS family and reachability facts without false DC or HTTPAPI exploit-banner promotion.

Nmap SMB vulnerability NSE scan reporting positive State: VULNERABLE for CVE-2009-3103 alongside negative ms10-054 and ms10-061 checks must mint scan.nmap.vuln and exploit.candidate without misclassifying the host as MS17-010.
Interactive Windows system32 command prompt turn returning nt authority\system must mint Windows foothold, OS family, and SYSTEM privilege facts.

Nmap service-version and script scan identifying IIS 10.0 on port 80, SMB signing not required on 139/445, and Jetty H2 Database Console on port 8082 must mint vuln.h2_console and service reachability facts.

On-host privilege enumeration showing enabled SeImpersonatePrivilege followed by JuicyPotato COM CLSID negotiation failure and WinPEAS NetNTLMv2 output must mint SeImpersonate leads, blocker.potato, and crackable NetNTLMv2 hash facts without claiming SYSTEM.

Local pwdump SAM hash dump formatted with NO PASSWORD*** in the disabled LM-hash field and 32-hex NT hashes must mint loot.sam, hash.ntlm, credential.candidate, and actionable credential.available without minting loot.ntds.

Nmap version and vulnerability-script scan reporting positive smb-vuln-ms17-010 (CVE-2017-0144), RDP CVE-2012-0002, and GoAhead HP Power Manager HTTP title on port 80 must mint smb.ms17_010 and service reachability facts.

MS17-010 named-pipe exploit run that connects over SMB but terminates with '[-] Did not find accessible named pipe!' must classify as a negative/failed attempt and never mint foothold or administrative access.

Buffer-overflow exploit script printing a comment-prefixed Usage banner line before firing payload and opening an outbound Netcat bind-shell session showing Microsoft Windows Version 6.1.7600 must mint foothold.windows and classify as success rather than environment-error.

Full TCP Nmap version and script scan identifying anonymous FTP on non-standard port 30021, MariaDB host-not-allowed on 3306, HTTP on 33033, and BarracudaServer.exe 6.5 on 45332/45443 must mint port:30021, ftp.anonymous_login, and exploit.versioned_banner without minting port:21.
Anonymous FTP root directory listing retrieved via curl ftp:// URL returning Unix ls -l rows for a Rails application tree must mint ftp.reachable and loot.files without minting port:21.
Disclosed Ruby on Rails config/secrets.yml retrieved over FTP containing an unquoted 128-hex production secret_key_base value must mint web.source_disclosed and credential.candidate.

Command-less PowerUp enumeration block reporting ModifiableServiceFile / Write-HijackDll service DLL hijacking alongside Winlogon Autologon DefaultUserName and DefaultPassword entries must mint privesc.dll_hijack_candidate, privesc.stored_credentials, and recovered plaintext credential facts.
Command-less Windows token-privilege output block showing enabled SeImpersonatePrivilege must mint privesc.windows_privilege, privesc.seimpersonate, and privesc.leads without claiming SYSTEM.
Command-less Windows identity output block returning NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM after token impersonation must mint foothold.windows, host.os_family, and access.system without Linux or DC false positives.

Full TCP Nmap version scan of an Active Directory Domain Controller exposing DNS 53, Kerberos 88, LDAP 389/3268 with inline Domain banner metadata, SMB 445, RDP 3389, and WinRM 5985 must mint DC candidacy and AD domain/base-DN facts without minting http.reachable from WinRM HTTPAPI.

OCR-spliced interactive smbclient guest session listing share contents and executing put reverse.exe (putting file reverse.exe as \reverse.exe) must mint smb.reachable, loot.files, and smb.writable_share.

OCR-spliced Evil-WinRM PowerShell turn listing automation scripts and dumping a 342-hex Windows DPAPI ConvertFrom-SecureString blob must mint WinRM foothold/authentication, loot.files, privesc.stored_credentials, and credential.candidate.

OCR-spliced external web-search and StackOverflow reference screenshot containing tutorial placeholder strings (TestPassword, P@ssw0rd) must never mint target credential.candidate, credential.available, or http.reachable facts.

Full RustScan and Nmap version/script sweep disclosing FTP, OpenSSH for Windows, HTTP, MSRPC, SMB, RDP, and high HTTP API ports. Must emit host reachability, open port inventory, service reachabilities, and OS hint without promoting a standalone Windows server to ad.dc_candidate or minting foothold/credential facts.

HTTP POST response returning PowerShell Format-List process properties where commandline wraps across an indented continuation line containing --user <user> and -p "<base64_secret>" for an outbound SSH command. Must unwrap the continuation line and decode/emit candidate and available credential material without minting foothold or web.authz_bypass.

Headerless curl response body returning HTML <pre> tags wrapping nt authority\system from an internal command-execution web endpoint. Must confirm OS command injection (web.cmdi_confirmed) alongside http.reachable without misclassifying the turn as SQL injection.
Command-only Nmap invocation turn with zero terminal stdout bytes where open ports are summarized only in surrounding Markdown prose. Must emit zero facts and classify outcome as unknown.

Unprompted code fence containing two unexecuted ldapsearch CLI lines and zero LDIF response lines. Must never extract ad.domain_known, ad.base_dn, or ldap.reachable from the -b base-DN argument of the second CLI command line.

Command-only Evil-WinRM pass-the-hash invocation with empty stdout and no interactive *Evil-WinRM* prompt telemetry. Must never infer credential validation or Windows shell foothold from CLI flags alone.

PowerShell session turn reading wp-config.php where DB_USER is defined with an empty DB_PASSWORD (''). Must retain Windows foothold from prompt telemetry while strictly suppressing plaintext password facts on an empty password literal.

Commandless PowerUp.ps1 enumeration snippet reporting a %PATH% HijackablePath (AbuseFunction: Write-HijackDll) and AlwaysInstallElevated registry check (AbuseFunction: Write-UserAddMSI). Must emit privesc.always_install_elevated, privesc.dll_hijack_candidate, and privesc.leads without minting administrative access.

Windows shell turn displaying fgdump/pwdump local SAM output where the LM hash column contains the 32-char placeholder NO PASSWORD********************* followed by valid 32-hex NT hashes. Must extract local NTLM hash credentials without misclassifying a local pwdump file as loot.ntds or hash.krbtgt.

Interactive FTP client turn receiving a 220 FileZilla Server version banner followed by '530 Login or password incorrect!' and 'Login failed.'. Must record FTP reachability and banner version while classifying outcome as rejected and forbidding anonymous login or credential validation.

Windows-Exploit-Suggester output listing [E] and [M] MSxx-xxx security bulletin rows against systeminfo patch inventory without same-line CVE identifiers. Must emit privesc.patch_gap and exploit.candidate without minting target foothold or administrative access.

Elevated Windows command shell whoami output returning <hostname>\administrator after scheduled-task binary replacement. Must confirm foothold.windows and access.admin without over-promoting local Administrator to access.system or ad.dc_candidate.

Commandless Nmap open-port table separated from its Command heading fence, listing MSRPC, NetBIOS/SMB, and 3128/tcp open http-proxy Squid http proxy. Must recognize open ports, Squid HTTP proxy service on 3128, and SMB reachability without minting AD DC or foothold facts.

Commandless single-row Windows token privilege line showing SeImpersonatePrivilege in Enabled state. Must emit privesc.windows_privilege, privesc.seimpersonate, and privesc.leads without assuming SYSTEM elevation prior to token-impersonation execution.

Post-exploitation whoami output returning nt authority\system after PrintSpoofer named-pipe impersonation. Must confirm foothold.windows and access.system without minting domain-controller or NTDS loot facts.

enum4linux-ng session probe where null session fails with STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED but random-username blank-password authentication succeeds ('[+] Server allows session using username ..., password ""'). Must emit smb.reachable and smb.guest_session while forbidding smb.null_session and authenticated credential validation.

Evil-WinRM connection turn with empty intermediate stdout followed directly by an interactive *Evil-WinRM* PS C:\Users\<user>\Desktop> prompt. Must derive winrm.authenticated, foothold.windows, access.shell, and credential.validated from prompt telemetry without promoting a non-admin user profile to access.admin.

Pre-escalation net user inspection inside an Evil-WinRM session showing membership in Remote Management Users and Server Operators (without Administrators). Must emit privesc.privileged_group along with user/group listing facts while forbidding access.admin prior to local Administrators group addition.

Remote Impacket secretsdump DRSUAPI extraction dumping Domain Controller NTDS hashes including Administrator and krbtgt. Must emit loot.ntds, hash.ntlm, hash.krbtgt, and credential.available without conflating remote DRSUAPI extraction with an interactive Windows shell foothold.
Command-only smbclient share-listing turn with zero terminal stdout bytes in a prose-summarized writeup. Must emit zero SMB facts and classify outcome as unknown.

Command-only Impacket PsExec invocation with empty stdout and no service-creation or cmd.exe banner proof. Must never emit foothold.windows, access.admin, access.system, or credential.validated from command arguments alone.

Command-less Nmap version and NSE scan of a Linux host exposing Apache HTTP (with http-enum subdirectories), Samba 445, and MariaDB 3306 must mint service reachability, web metadata, web.paths, and Linux OS family without claiming Active Directory roles or shell foothold.

smbmap share permission table showing READ ONLY access on a non-default share and NO ACCESS on administrative shares must mint smb.shares, smb.readable_share, and smb.content_accessible without claiming write access or host foothold.

Interactive MariaDB query dumping application user rows with bcrypt hash digests must mint db.reachable, db.session, db.hashes, hash.crackable, and credential.candidate without claiming plaintext credentials or OS shell access.

Netcat reverse-shell listener receiving an inbound TCP connection followed by interactive POSIX bash job-control stderr lines must mint listener.open, access.shell, and foothold.linux without claiming administrative privileges.

RustScan and Nmap NSE output showing OpenSSH 22 and Apache HTTP 80 with http-ls directory index entries must mint host.up, ports.open, ssh.reachable, http.reachable, web.server, web.paths, and Linux OS family without claiming foothold or RCE.
Exploit script invocation with zero captured stdout must classify outcome as unknown and never hallucinate web.rce, access.shell, or foothold.linux from CLI arguments alone.

Post-foothold SUID enumeration from a low-privilege Unix prompt returning an interpreter binary path must mint foothold.linux, privesc.suid_candidate, privesc.suid, and privesc.leads without claiming root privileges prior to exploitation.
Privileged SUID subshell invocation spawning a root hash prompt where echoed whoami outputs root must mint foothold.linux, access.shell, access.admin, and access.root.

RustScan and Nmap scan exposing OpenSSH 22 and HTTP services on ports 80 and 33017 must mint host.up, ports.open, ssh.reachable, http.reachable, web.server, web.title, and Linux OS family without claiming authenticated SSH or foothold.

Interactive SSH connection without MOTD banner output that transitions directly to a non-attacker remote Unix user shell prompt must mint ssh.authenticated, access.shell, and foothold.linux without claiming root privileges.

Root shell prompt running cat proof.txt with omitted stdout must mint foothold.linux, access.admin, and access.root from verified root prompt telemetry while refusing to claim objective.flag_captured without flag digest output.

Command-less Nmap scan of a Linux host running OpenSSH 22, versionless OpenSMTPD 25, HTTP 80, and Samba 445 must mint service reachability and OS family facts without fabricating exploit.versioned_banner from a versionless SMTP banner or promoting to ad.dc_candidate.
Interactive smbclient connection printing Anonymous login successful and directory entries must mint smb.reachable and smb.null_session without claiming write access or shell foothold.

Post-exploitation compound identity and uname probe returning uid=0(root) and Linux kernel release metadata must mint access.shell, foothold.linux, access.admin, access.root, host.kernel, host.arch, and host.os_family.

Gobuster directory brute-force discovering application admin/config paths alongside an exposed /.git/HEAD (HTTP 200) must mint web.content_map, web.paths, and web.exposed_artifact without claiming RCE or credential recovery.

Disclosed PHP configuration file containing a nested associative array with MySQL user and plaintext password entries must mint web.source_disclosed, credential.candidate, credential.plaintext, credential.available, and db.creds without claiming live database authentication or shell foothold.

Sudoers privilege listing returning (ALL : ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL on a non-root Linux prompt must mint foothold.linux, privesc.sudo_rights, and privesc.leads while never misparsing the NOPASSWD directive token into a credential.candidate or claiming root access before sudo execution.

Full-port Nmap scan of a Linux host exposing OpenSSH 22, Sendmail 25, Apache HTTP 80, Samba 139/445, and a high TCP port must mint service reachability and Linux OS family without promoting standalone Samba to ad.dc_candidate.
Anonymous smbclient -L share metadata listing showing IPC$ and printer shares without opening a share must mint smb.shares without claiming readable or writable file share content.
Paired command and output turn executing id and returning uid=0(root) gid=0(root) must mint access.shell, foothold.linux, access.admin, and access.root.

RustScan and Nmap scan exposing OpenSSH 22, Apache 80, Samba 139/445, Ruby HTTP 3000, and FreeSWITCH mod_event_socket 8021 must mint service reachability, vuln.freeswitch, and Linux OS family without claiming foothold or admin access.
Event-socket command execution script returning Authentication failed must classify outcome polarity as rejected and mint zero shell, foothold, or RCE facts.

Arbitrary file-read dump of a service XML configuration containing a self-closing <param name="password" value="<redacted>"/> element must extract credential.candidate and credential.password with outcome success without claiming live authentication or shell foothold.

Post-foothold find command locating local.txt inside a service directory from a non-root shell prompt must mint foothold.linux, objective.flag_located, and objective.flag_located_local without falsely triggering vuln.freeswitch from a local filesystem path component or claiming flag capture.

RustScan and Nmap version/NSE scan discovering OpenSSH on 22, Apache HTTP on 80, and TLS web console on 9090 (ssl/zeus-admin? returning HTTP/1.1 400 Bad request) must mint host reachability, open ports, HTTP/SSH reachability, web title/server, and Linux OS family without claiming foothold or AD roles.
FFUF PHP endpoint enumeration discovering login and logout routes must mint web.content_map and web.paths without claiming SQL injection or credential recovery.

On-target user shell sudo -l listing NOPASSWD wildcard tar archive execution must mint foothold.linux, privesc.sudo_rights, privesc.sudo_binary, and privesc.leads without claiming root access, custom binary, or credential candidates.

RustScan and Nmap version/NSE output with HTTP redirect to a virtual-host FQDN and http-robots.txt disallowed web paths must mint host/port/service reachability, http.redirect, host.fqdn, and web.paths without claiming foothold or AD roles.
Command-only exploit invocation fence with omitted stdout must classify as unknown and never hallucinate Linux foothold or validated credentials from CLI arguments alone.

LinPEAS /etc/crontab excerpt showing root-owned 0644 /etc/crontab executing a bespoke /opt shell script (without writable permissions shown on crontab or script) must mint privesc.cron, privesc.custom_binary, host.notable_program, and privesc.leads without falsely asserting privesc.cron_writable or root access.
Gobuster directory enumeration discovering filemanager and WordPress routes must mint web.content_map and web.paths without claiming foothold or LFI confirmation.

Reading a PHP user-table config file containing bcrypt ($2a$08$) and MD5 account entries must mint foothold.linux, web.source_disclosed, hash.crackable, hash.candidate, and credential.candidate without claiming cleartext password recovery or root access.

Command-less LinPEAS All users & groups multi-account dump listing uid=0(root) alongside a standard user in group 6(disk) must mint host.os_family, privesc.privileged_group, and privesc.leads, and MUST NOT falsely claim access.root or access.admin from the system-wide user table.

Raw block-device /etc/shadow dump via debugfs must mint foothold.linux, loot.shadow, hash.crackable, hash.candidate, and credential.candidate without claiming root shell access or cracked plaintext passwords.

Web arbitrary-file-read exploit script interactively reading /etc/passwd over HTTP must mint web.lfi_confirmed, loot.files, and host.os_family without claiming interactive shell foothold or root access.

Truncated LinPEAS excerpt reporting kernel version and active user membership in group 6(disk) must classify as success (never completed-negative) and mint foothold.linux, host.kernel, host.os_family, privesc.privileged_group, and privesc.leads.

Extracting an unencrypted OpenSSH private key via debugfs must mint foothold.linux, loot.ssh_key, credential.ssh_key, and credential.certificate without marking the unencrypted key as hash.crackable or claiming root access.

RustScan and Nmap version/NSE scan exposing SSH on 22, web application port 8090, and Aleph/0.4.6 HTTP service on 8091 must mint open ports, service reachability, web.server, service.version, and exploit.versioned_banner without claiming foothold.
Zero-stdout RCE script execution fence must classify as unknown and never mint foothold.linux or access.shell from command arguments alone.

LinPEAS excerpt containing Useful software binary paths (/usr/bin/gettext.sh, /usr/bin/rescan-scsi-bus.sh) and user-added /opt script listing without any SUID section or -rws mode bits must mint foothold.linux and host.notable_program while never hallucinating privesc.suid or privesc.suid_candidate.
Gobuster directory scan on non-standard port 30455 discovering /index.php and /phpinfo.php must mint web.content_map and web.paths without claiming web.source_disclosed before phpinfo.php is fetched.

cases.command: (commandless HTTP POST SQLi INTO OUTFILE request and 200 response)
cases.note: Paired outbound HTTP POST request injecting a PHP webshell via SQLi INTO OUTFILE and receiving an empty-body HTTP/1.1 200 response must mint http.reachable without misclassifying the attacker's outbound request payload as server-disclosed PHP source or a disclosed server-side vulnerability sink.

Bare sh-5.1# root shell prompt executing cat proof.txt with omitted flag stdout must mint foothold.linux, access.root, access.admin, and host.os_family from prompt telemetry without hallucinating objective.root_flag or proof.captured.

SMB share directory listing attempt returning NT_STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED must classify as authorization-denied and mint smb.reachable plus blocker.access_denied without claiming readable share access or looted files.

Empty-stdout curl POST delivering an OS reverse-shell payload must classify as unknown (never completed-negative) and never claim foothold or command-injection confirmation without response or listener evidence.

On-target user shell sudo -l showing (root) NOPASSWD: /sbin/halt, /sbin/reboot, /sbin/poweroff must mint foothold.linux, privesc.sudo_rights, and privesc.leads while never misclassifying stock OS power binaries as privesc.custom_binary or parsing NOPASSWD: /sbin/halt as a credential.candidate password.

RustScan and Nmap version/NSE output for a Linux host exposing HTTP proxy/web on 8080, Samba SMB on 12445, HTTP Git service on 18030, and OpenSSH on 43022 must mint all non-standard port, reachability, web title, and Linux OS facts without promoting to an Active Directory domain controller.

Interactive SSH login on non-standard port 43022 showing password entry and landing at a remote bracketed POSIX shell prompt ([<user>@<host> ~]$) must extract the plaintext credential and establish ssh.authenticated, access.shell, foothold.linux, and Linux OS family.

Partial linpeas.sh output disclosing /etc/crontab.bak and a readable RSA private key (-rwxr-xr-x, mode 0755, non-SUID) must extract loot.ssh_key and credential.ssh_key while never hallucinating privesc.suid from PEM base64 lines starting with '/' and containing the substring 'rws'.
Elevated POSIX shell prompt (sh-5.0#) executing whoami and returning root must establish foothold.linux, access.shell, access.admin, access.root, and Linux OS family.

Interactive web CVE exploit PoC REPL executing whoami against --host http://<target> and returning www-data must confirm remote web command execution (web.cmdi_confirmed) and http.reachable without claiming root privilege.

linpeas.sh 'All users & groups' section executed from an unprivileged www-data shell prompt listing system accounts (including uid=0(root) and a non-root sudo group member) must preserve foothold.linux and never mint access.root or access.admin from enumerated account rows.

pspy64 process monitor output showing a recurring scheduled command under another local user UID (CMD: UID=1001 PID=<pid> | /bin/sh -c /usr/bin/php /var/www/html/<app>/artisan clear:pictures) must mint privesc.process_lead, privesc.custom_binary, and privesc.leads.
Shell redirection attempting to overwrite a protected application manifest and returning 'bash: .../composer.json: Permission denied' must classify as authorization-denied without elevating access.
Command-only Nmap code fence with omitted stdout must classify as unknown and emit zero host or port facts.
Command-only Exploit-DB Python invocation fence with zero stdout and no listener output must classify as unknown and never hallucinate a shell foothold.

Promptless command-only getcap code fence with zero stdout (where the author placed the capability output in a separate code fence) must classify as unknown rather than falsely retiring getcap as completed-negative.

ffuf directory and extension fuzzing discovering backups (301), index.html (200), server-status (403), and upload (301) must mint web.content_map, web.paths, web.upload_form, and http.reachable without claiming upload exploitation.

Outbound-only raw HTTP multipart POST /upload.php request containing an MZ-prefixed PHP webshell body with no HTTP server response must classify as unknown and emit zero confirmed upload or foothold facts.

SUID file discovery from an unprivileged Linux target shell returning a non-standard binary under /opt must mint privesc.suid, privesc.suid_candidate, privesc.custom_binary, privesc.leads, and foothold.linux.

Command-less Nmap version and NSE table exposing FTP (21/tcp), SSH (22/tcp), HTTP (80/tcp), and PostgreSQL on non-standard port 5437/tcp must mint port, service, and database reachability facts (postgres.reachable and db.reachable) alongside Linux OS family.

PostgreSQL SELECT output returning rows populated by COPY FROM PROGRAM 'whoami;id;hostname;uname -a' must establish db.session, db.reachable, access.shell, foothold.linux, host.kernel, host.arch, and Linux OS family without claiming root privilege.
Root shell /etc/shadow dump containing SHA-512 crypt ($6$) password hashes must mint loot.shadow, hash.crackable, hash.candidate, and credential.candidate without Windows or NTLM false positives.

WPScan output identifying WordPress version, enumerated users, and an outdated plugin with an explicit version number (simple-file-list 4.2.2) must mint web.cms, web.tech, web.users, http.reachable, and exploit.versioned_banner for downstream Exploit-DB lookup.

Linux target shell reading wp-config.php containing DB_USER and DB_PASSWORD definitions must extract credential.plaintext, credential.available, credential.candidate, db.creds, foothold.linux, and Linux OS family without claiming credential validation.
DOSBox virtual Z:\> prompt mounting the Linux root directory '/' onto drive K ('Drive K is mounted as local directory /') must never hallucinate foothold.windows or flip host.os_family to windows.

RustScan and Nmap -sVC scan table with syn-ack REASON column disclosing OpenSSH on 22/tcp, Apache httpd on 80/tcp, and fingerprint-strings HTTP Server Maltrail/0.52 on 8338/tcp must strip syn-ack and mint port, HTTP/SSH reachability, service version, versioned banner, and Linux OS family.

Zero-stdout exploit launcher turn whose reverse shell lands asynchronously in a separate listener turn must classify outcome as unknown and never fabricate shell access or command injection confirmation from CLI arguments alone.

LinPEAS section listing executable files potentially added by user with a timestamped shell script path under /var/backups must mint foothold.linux, host.os_family, host.notable_program, privesc.custom_binary, and privesc.leads without claiming administrative access.

Command-less Nmap service and NSE scan disclosing OpenSSH, Apache/PHP shopping cart title, Dovecot POP3/IMAP with TLS certificate subject commonName, and Samba 3.0.26a must mint Linux OS family, service reachability, SMB signing, and hostname without Active Directory false positives.

Linux target shell reading PHP configuration defining scalar $db_host, $db_name, $db_user, and $db_password variables must extract credential.candidate, credential.plaintext, credential.available, db.creds, foothold.linux, and host.os_family without claiming credential validation.
